title: Buddy Bertrand, waiter and pianist
summary: Bertrand worked as a first-class waiter and also played piano on the same jobs; he died some years earlier and was a native New Orleanian.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

He's a waiter and he used to play piano too. He played the piano.
